failure.message: Kubernetes 1.34 is past Azure Kubernetes Service standard support (ended 2026-11-30)

testcase.failure: Kubernetes 1.34 is past Azure Kubernetes Service standard support (ended 2026-11-30). Azure Kubernetes Service ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-11-30; extended support, which applies only if Long Term Support is enabled, runs until 2027-11-30; upgradescope cannot see whether this cluster is enrolled. AKS has no automatic extended support. Past community support a cluster is in platform support (Azure and AKS platform issues only, no Kubernetes fixes) unless Long Term Support is enabled, which needs the Premium tier. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support. References: - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/supported-kubernetes-versions
